evidence.reason: Restricted the undeclared-source foreign flag in _scan_dependencies to CRQ names inside the expected set while keeping the flag for declared sources naming units outside it, so installed units of other CRQ groups no longer refuse every switch, with the discovery-scope doc and discovery tests updated (including a regression test for the crq-publisher scenario) and drop-in coverage at discover confirmed independent of the scan; tests were not run because the harness permits only git commands, so CI is the authority.
